concepts: daily weekly and monthly order volume
semantics: Business dates use Asia/Kolkata and half-open ranges: start inclusive and end_exclusive exclusive.
Plain orders, orders placed, order count and order volume mean placed-order population unless the request explicitly asks for qualifying or non-cancelled orders.
Placed-order population does not automatically exclude orders that were later cancelled.
Qualifying-order population excludes orders whose native status is canceled/cancelled OR whose non-null Zoho operational status is CANCELED/CANCELLED.
order.canceled_at is not canonical full-cancellation truth.
By default, fulfilled orders means operationally fulfilled: order.zoho_order_status = FULFILLED.
order.status, order.fulfillment_status, order.payment_status, order.zoho_order_status and fulfillment.delivery_status are distinct concepts.
Do not use order.delivery_status as actual delivery truth.
Counting orders after one-to-many joins requires preserving order.id grain.
Store-level historical order attribution uses order.store_id.
Explicit historical B2B segmentation uses order.is_b2b when that physical field is available.
Monetary definitions such as AOV, captured value, refunds and net collected value belong to the money domain rather than operations.
Predictive numerical output belongs to deterministic Rust forecasting rather than generated SQL.
